title: Graceful shutdown drain
prompt: A worker must stop ACCEPTING new work immediately on shutdown, but finish what it already accepted. Implement `static async Task<List<int>> ShutdownDrain(int feedCount, int shutdownAfter)`: a producer writes integers 0..feedCount-1; after `shutdownAfter` items have been WRITTEN, the producer calls TryComplete (no more accepts) — but every item written before completion must still be consumed by a background reader collecting them via ReadAllAsync. Return the collected list. The test asserts shutdownAfter items arrive, nothing more.

tests.name: drain-exact
tests.hint: In the producer loop: if (i == shutdownAfter) writer.TryComplete(); then WriteAsync(i) — but TryComplete BEFORE the writes you want accepted... order: write i, then when i == shutdownAfter-1, TryComplete after the write. Items already buffered are still delivered to ReadAllAsync after completion.
